## Stopped-tasks audit — 4 masterminds

| Task | Mastermind session + cwd | Last state (own words) | Worktree branch + unmerged/uncommitted | What's left to land | $ spent | Recommendation |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| voice-sessions | `54d84d0f…` @ monorepo | "Ruled on all 12 findings... Fix minion (resumed slice-2 session) queued at position 5" — then stopped before the fix round ran | `worktree/qf-9` — **0 unmerged commits** (slice-1/2 already merged as ced6b950); 0 uncommitted files (only log-churn `files.jsonl` diffs) | The 9 approved fixes from `e-fixes/requirements.md` were never applied — queued, not run | not logged | **RESUME** — cleanly queued, nothing to reconcile |
| chat-hitl | `0c78d2c5…` @ monorepo, task_dir `audio/next-chat-hitl` | "task-loop escalated: no card 'live'" at 22:08, right after a proof posted 3x as owner into live chat.jsonl | `worktree/chat-hitl` — **2 unmerged commits** (`ec5c770f` marks/rename/clarify, `21337659` WIP parked); no uncommitted code | Slice-2 (marks, rename, revision pairs) needs its smoke test + merge; the 3 stray owner-posted lines in `ext/Chat/ai/chat.jsonl` (21:33-21:36) still need marking | ≥$7.70 (widgets) + capped $4 (wire), budget $20 | **RESUME** — work looks done but must clear the posting-incident lines before merge |
| node-reliability | `486964ae…` @ monorepo | "one-pass roles stop themselves... reviewer stopped, minion idle (queue-proof 15/15)" — all 9 review findings answered (7 fixed, 2 noted) | `worktree/node-reliability` — **2 unmerged commits** (`35c5acdf` jsonl-keep, `20fc8cb9` doc); no uncommitted code | Just needs `merge.mjs` smoke test + merge — review clean, proofs 22/22 and 15/15 | not logged | **MERGE-AND-LAND by hand** — nothing left to decide |
| page-system-3-3 | `0dee9f82…` @ monorepo (parent task-mastermind-page-system chain, stopped on purpose by mastermind-servex-7, not revived) | Last own action: edited `inventory-audit.md` at 21:17, mid audit-crawl (62/81) | `worktree/page-system` — **6 unmerged commits** (Page overview flow-rhythm, snippet formatting, columns); **4 untracked paths** incl. a junk `undefined/` dir and a stray `public/framework/ai/2026/09/25/...` tree | Finish the inventory audit (feeds the separate cards-and-logs task), clean the stray/junk dirs, then smoke-test + merge | $48.17 (whole page-system chain, shared with sibling threads page-system-2/-3) | **RESUME** — real unmerged work, but the junk untracked dirs need a human look before merge |

**Main tree:** `git status --short` in the main repo shows only the usual live `.jsonl`/`files.jsonl`/`board.jsonl` log churn (board, cards, todo, per-task logs) — normal while agents run, not code belonging to any of these 4 tasks. No abandoned code changes sitting in the main tree.

**Other note:** `task-mastermind-page-system` (the parent of -3-3) already has its own separate live successor thread (`task-mastermind-page-system-2`, worktree `page-system-929`) still running — not in scope here, didn't touch it.

I applied all 13 lines, marked each one ` → applied 2026-09-30` in its improvements.md, and committed them as `c4302795`. The two lines you marked skip were left alone.

| skill | where the line went | the sentence I wrote |
|---|---|---|
| code | §7, Blast radius (first item) | Before you add a static import to any file that `Page.class.js` or `core/Page/Log.js` reaches, grep whether the new target imports `Page.class.js` back. If it does, load it with a dynamic `import()` inside the function that needs it, and load a real page after the edit. |
| code | §7, The tools themselves (first item; the skill has no testing section) | In a Node test, set `process.env` first and then `await import()` the module that reads it. |
| css | Step 1, the existing container-query ⚠ | Put the size-changing rule on a plain descendant wrapper (one extra div), and let the container only provide the measured box. |
| css | Step 1, a new ⚠ after it | A closed `<details>` drops everything but its `<summary>`, and no CSS brings it back. Keep it empty but for its summary, put the content as its next sibling, and style that sibling with `~`. |
| documentation | §1 readme, after the "one click down" paragraph | Name a file with a link, not a bare path: `file_link(path, line?)` on a page, a link to its page in markdown. Name a method with its class-doc member page (`/framework/<module>/api/<method>/`) when one exists. |
| finish-task | §3, before the landing line | First, run `git status --short` and look for every file this task touched. If any is still uncommitted, commit it by exact path before you land. |
| minion | Quick fixes, step 3 | A full-size branch is refused until `node Server/review.mjs <taskdir> <worktree>` has run, and that needs a `requirements.md` in the task dir. |
| minion | Quick fixes, step 6 | If `take_worktree()` says all are taken, run `node Server/worktree-up.mjs <slug>`: it makes a private worktree with its own server. If that fails too, message your parent. |
| minion | While working | If the health-guard hook blocks a write and its `at` timestamp is not moving, load the named page headless yourself. If it shows real content and no console errors, log that the finding is stale and carry on. |
| minion | How to wait | A Servex restart kills any run you started as your own child, so ask your mastermind to launch a run that must survive (detached, `windowsHide`, `unref`). |
| sub-mastermind | Broken pages reach you at once | ⚠ The worktree supervisor does not start while the main one runs, because `health.mjs` holds one global lock. Until the lock is per-base, check worktree pages with `merge.mjs`'s smoke test or a headless probe. |
| sub-mastermind | Keep everything moving | Send a correction to a working minion queued, not `now`; if you did send a `now`, follow it with a plain "continue". |
| sub-mastermind | Keep everything moving, long-running helpers | Start a minion's long run yourself, detached, and tell the minion to end its turn and wait for your wake. A Monitor wait re-reads its whole context every ~10 s, and a Servex restart kills any run a minion started. |
| sub-mastermind | Split the task (brief writing) | When the task builds a card, say in the brief to write the card's files last, right before the merge. |
| sub-mastermind | Decide the worktree, merge list | `merge.mjs` runs the MAIN tree's `smoke.mjs`: fix the page, or land the smoke fix first. |
| sub-mastermind | Decide the worktree, the shared-sibling paragraph | A sibling that is itself a task mastermind cannot be messaged directly (`policy.js` blocks it), so relay through the architect. |
| todo.md | ## 2. Only you can do | health.mjs lock is global (Temp/lew42-health.lock): make it per-base. |

**Where I departed from the instructions:**
- **Commit contents:** I didn't run `git add .claude/skills public/framework/ai/todo.md`. That would have committed other agents' unsaved work: `clarity/flags.jsonl`, `ui-test/improvements.md`, the new `openrouter/` folder, and someone else's "Servex project-aware" line in todo.md. Instead I staged the 12 skill files by name, and staged todo.md as it stands in git plus only my line. All of that other work is still uncommitted in the tree.
- **Link fix:** the code-skill import rule links to the `2026-09-29/page-system` task folder, because no `page-fix-tabs` folder exists.
